title: HGroupComponent
description: A way to render another component multiple times creating groups of data

sourceConnectorName.title: Input connector
sourceConnectorName.description: Optional data connector feeding this component

keyMappings.title: Nested key mappings
keyMappings.description: Optional: map group columns to nested connector columns for filtering. Leave empty to match columns by the same name.

groupComponent.title: Group component
groupComponent.description: The nested component rendered once per group key

rotation.title: Rotation (degrees)
rotation.description: Rotation angle in degrees around the component center

transparency.title: Transparency (0-100)
transparency.description: Opacity as a percentage: 0 = invisible, 100 = fully opaque

clipSize.title: Clip size
clipSize.description: When width and height are set (>0), drawing is clipped to the component geometry
